results.title: Fan‑Made Windows Port Lets Players Re‑Experience Pokémon: Let's Go on PC
results.description: A community project called Let's Go Recomp has successfully turned Nintendo Switch titles Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! into native Windows applications by statically recompiling the original ARM64 code into C. The result is a PC‑compatible build that supports resolutions from 720p to 4K, optional 60‑fps rendering, keyboard/mouse and controller input, and a robust runtime for graphics, audio and system interaction. Though still incomplete, the port delivers the core gameplay loop, including exploration, encounters, and battles, while requiring players to supply legal copy data and follow a manual build process. It is a vibrant demonstration of fandom ingenuity, albeit with limitations such as no online play or Cross‑platform features.

results.title: Fort Worth QB Keaton Rose Out for Season With Leukemia, Team Rallies Behind Him
results.description: Chisholm Trail quarterback Keaton Rose will miss the rest of the season after a leukemia diagnosis, as Fort Worth rallies to support his family.
